name: SAI's fate.
about:
I’m an artist and producer that makes ambient and melodic trap music, in a similar fashion to Lil Uzi Vert, Draingang, Future and similar acts. I Started off as a producer making beats as a hobby, eventually I started to write to my beats and became an artist too. I’m very hands on and have a D.I.Y. philosophy towards production so I created my own label ‘OMOcloud.’ with my friends that shared interests in music and art.

Before “SAI’s fate.”, I was making beats and songs under a different alias, finding opportunities with underground artists at the time. However after a while, I decided to go back to simply producing and to focus on progressing my craft.

As of late(2025) I dropped my first ever album “SYSTEMS THINKING”. A self produced project released under ⠕ OMOcloud.
